slots.name: prior cost increase
slots.sentence: That forecast is up from a projection just a few weeks ago for a 31.3% increase, said the nonprofit that represents state directors of the federal Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program, which assists low-income Americans with energy needs.

slots.name: Northeast oil homes
slots.sentence: In the Northeast, 82% of homes rely on heating oil.

slots.name: Maine oil homes
slots.sentence: Maine has the highest proportion of homes that use heating oil (59%), followed by the rest of New England and Alaska, noted Pavel Molchanov, a Raymond James investment strategy analyst.

slots.name: prior average cost
slots.sentence: Across America, for now, the average cost of heating a home with oil is expected to increase by about $878, to about $2,627 this winter, up from about $1,749 last year, NEADA said.

slots.name: prior Maine cost
slots.sentence: Among states in those regions, those living in Maine will pay the most, averaging $2,939 this winter, up from $1,664 last year.

slots.name: LIHEAP funding request
slots.sentence: That is why we have asked Congress for $3 billion in supplemental emergency LIHEAP funding.

slots.name: heating cost increase percentage
slots.sentence: A 50% increase in heating costs is simply too much for a family living paycheck to paycheck to absorb.
